classification: legacy Emerald PokéNav animated BG3 decoration behind the already-live authentic HGSS PokéGear shell

behavior: loads legacy dot tiles, tilemap, and palette during menu initialization
crossfades dot palette between light blue and purple for menu transitions

findings: PokegearApp_InitBGs initializes the core PokéGear MAIN_0 and SUB_0 layers only
PokegearApp_LoadSkinGraphics loads the authentic app-switch and fixed-shell skin resources onto those core layers
additional layers are owned/cleared by applications; the core PokéGear does not install a shared animated moving-dot background
retail_audit.conclusion: there is no retail HGSS shared moving-dot counterpart to import; retaining Emerald bg_dots under the HGSS shell is non-authentic

authentic_counterpart.role: default-skin fixed PokéGear shell with app-owned additional layers

next: After Phase-1 CI passes, suppress the legacy BG3 moving-dot load/scroll/palette behavior behind a rollback path while leaving source assets in place for the validation cycle.
